sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V.Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.7969 of 2023
Order:

This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioners, seeking the following relief:
"....to issue an appropriate writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus directing respondent Nos.3 and 4 to issue guidelines to be adopted for laying the Public Underground Drainage Lines inside/Within the Compound Wall premises of the petitioner herein by respondent No.4 in the private property and also direct respondent Nos.3 and 4 5o issue appropriate notices for the acquisition/assurance or any alternate compensation to the petitioner and pass appropriate orders...."

2. The petitioner claims to be the owner and possessor of the land to an extent of Ac.0.36 gts.,
situated in Sy.No.81/2 at Jeedimetla Village, Quthbullapur Mandal, Medhcal-Malkajgiri District.

The case of the petitioner is that the said property is mutated in the revenue records vide ROR Proceedings No.A/7719/02, dated 31.10.2002 and the revenue authorities have also issued Pattadar Passbook to the petitioner under the provisions of the Telangana (Rights in Land) and Pattadar Passbooks Act, 1971 and the Rules made thereunder.

3. The grievance of the petitioner is that the respondents, without following the due procedure as prescribed under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and the National Highways Authority of India Act,
1988 and without even issuing the copy of the Underground Drainage Lines Rules to enable him to agitate his claim before the appropriate authority, are frequently interfering with his possession over the patta land for the purpose of laying Public Underground Drainage Lines inside/within the compound premises of the petitioner.

entities.text:

1988
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Respondent No.4 has filed a counter affidavit stating that National Highways Authority of India has been developing 4-6 laning work, along with fly overs and service roads, within the available land of 250 feet.

State R&B, National Highway Division has handed over the land to NHAI in the years 2000 and 2001 and they are proceeding with expansion of road in the right of way from Bowenpally to Medchal check-post within a length of 16 K.Ms on NH 44.
5.

Mr.Padma Rao, learned Standing Counsel for NHAI appearing for respondent Nos.2 to 4 would submit that the present Writ Petition is filed seeking to furnish the guidelines for laying of the Underground Drainage Lines in the private properties while proceeding to expansion of roads.
It is stated that in terms of interim order passed by this Court the Rules as on today in force are furnished to the petitioner.

However, it is submitted by the learned Standing Counsel that by virtue of expanding the road from 4 lane to 6 lane, the properties of the petitioner are no way affected and M.N Upendra Nath vs The Union Of India on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23781671/

sentences.text: 1 if any evidence is placed by the petitioner to show that his properties are being affected, the respondents would take appropriate action, in accordance with law.

6. In view of the above submissions and since it is stated that the properties of the petitioner are not being affected by virtue of road widening, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of this Writ Petition directing the respondents to take appropriate action by following due procedure of law, in case the petitioner produces any documentary evidence to the satisfaction of the respondents regarding the loss sustained by him due to the above said works undertaken by the respondents.
7. With the above observations, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
8. As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.

C.V.BHASKAR REDDY, J Date: 11.09.2024 ynk M.N Upendra Nath vs The Union Of India on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23781671/
